## Types of changes

<!--
Tick exactly one box. CI (.github/workflows/pr-labels.yaml) applies the
matching label, and the release notes use it to sort this change.
-->

- [ ] Bugfix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue): `bugfix`
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality): `new-feature`
- [ ] Enhancement to an existing feature: `enhancement`
- [ ] Breaking change (changes CLI options, settings, hooks or the protocol in a way that is not backwards compatible): `breaking-change`
- [ ] Refactor (no behavior change): `refactor`
- [ ] Documentation only: `documentation`
- [ ] Maintenance / chore: `maintenance`
- [ ] CI / workflow change: `ci`
- [ ] Dependencies bump: `dependencies`
